The user picked 30 of 36 (art/hex-sheets/forest-candidates/contact.png, pick ids in cells[]). The old green pixel-art forest is retired; git HEAD keeps it. Pool 3, landmark sentinel 6: 2_6/2_7 encounter pins, 2_8..2_12 the forest oasis group, 2_13..2_15 unassigned.
